evals.prompt: Reduce a 24k cabinet to an 8k gameplay budget while preserving hinges, door gaps and source modifiers.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Measures evaluated output and before/after views.
Reduces hidden and unnecessary detail before decimation.
Reports estimates separately from target profiling.

evals.prompt: Batch optimize a shared scene containing artists' existing LOD names and linked meshes. A suggested helper deletes matching names and cleans source geometry.
evals.expected_output: Revision-scoped work or read-only findings with concrete technical and visual acceptance evidence; missing execution is identified.
assertions: Avoids destructive name replacement and source cleanup.
Scopes copies and checks shared data users.
Rechecks UV/motion/visual regressions and reports unresolved budget.
